content_sections.heading: Official Source
content_sections.text: This article is based on the official notification of Central Reserve Police Force, dated 16 November 2026. Candidates should verify every detail in that notification before applying.

faq.question: Q1. When is the walk-in interview for CRPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 15 December 2026 (17 December 2026 for CH, CRPF, Avadi, CH, CRPF, Jagdalpur and CH, CRPF, Gandhinagar), and candidates report at 9:00 AM.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in CRPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 19 vacancies: 1 Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Prayagraj, 1 Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Avadi, 1 Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Raipur, 2 Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon and Ophthalmology) - CH, CRPF, Bhopal, 1 Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Muzaffarpur, 2 Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon and Anesthesia) - CH, CRPF, Rampur and 8 more posts.

faq.question: Q3. How do I apply for CRPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Attend the walk-in interview on 15 December 2026 (17 December 2026 for CH, CRPF, Avadi, CH, CRPF, Jagdalpur and CH, CRPF, Gandhinagar) at 9:00 AM. The steps and the documents to bring are under How to Apply above.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The age limit is below 70 years (as on date of Walk-in-interview).

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for this recruitment?
faq.answer: It depends on the post: Rs. 85,000 P.M for Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Prayagraj, Rs. 85,000 P.M for Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Avadi, Rs. 85,000 P.M for Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Raipur, Rs. 85,000 P.M for Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon and Ophthalmology) - CH, CRPF, Bhopal, Rs. 85,000 P.M for Specialist Medical Officer (Surgeon) - CH, CRPF, Muzaffarpur.

faq.question: Q6. What qualification is needed for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Recognised allopathic medical qualification under the Indian Medical Council Act, 1956, compulsory rotating internship, and a Post Graduate Degree/Diploma in the concerned specialty with 1.5 years' (PG Degree) or 2.5 years' (PG Diploma) experience in that specialty. The requirement for each post is in the eligibility table above.

faq.question: Q7. Are there other conditions for this recruitment besides qualification and age?
faq.answer: Yes. Male and female Specialist Medical Officers may apply. Willing and eligible candidates below 70 years as on date of Walk-in-interview.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Walk-in interview. Medical examination. Interview will be followed by Medical Examination.

faq.question: Q9. What are the terms of engagement for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Appointment is on contractual basis in Composite Hospitals. No TA/DA will be paid during the period of engagement in CRPF on contractual basis/hiring basis.

faq.question: Q10. Which places are covered by CRPF Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Prayagraj, Avadi, Raipur, Bhopal, Muzaffarpur, Rampur, Ranchi, Silchar, Hyderabad, Jammu, Bhubaneswar, Jagdalpur, Pune, Gandhinagar.
